Name: the takeaway. Style: Fried chicken, burgers and pizza. Town: Nottingham.
Hours: Monday to Thursday and Sunday: 12 noon till 11pm. Friday and Saturday: 12 noon till midnight.
Collection: yes. Delivery to NG5 is £2.50, with a £12 minimum. Delivery is free on orders of £30 or more.
Orders are paid by card on the phone, when you collect, or to the driver in cash or by card.
Our chicken is halal; our other meat is not. We cook in a shared kitchen and fryers, so we can't rule out traces of any allergen.

Parking: You can park in the bays out front for up to 20 minutes while you collect. Bags: Your food comes in a paper bag, at no charge. Tips: Tips for the drivers are welcome, and they keep all of them. Jobs: We're often looking for drivers and kitchen staff: ask for the manager in the shop.
